description: You are a critical care nurse preparing the monitoring station for a post-cardiac surgery patient being admitted to the ICU. You need to configure OpenICE to track multiple physiological parameters simultaneously using three distinct monitoring devices. Create three simulated device adapters covering different physiological domains: (1) a Multiparameter Monitor for primary vital signs (ECG, SpO2, hemodynamics), (2) a CO2 or respiratory gas monitoring device (for end-tidal CO2 and ventilation status), and (3) one additional monitoring device of your choice from the available simulated types in OpenICE. After creating all three devices, launch the Vital Signs clinical application and confirm that data from all three devices is flowing. Navigate to the device detail view for at least one device to observe its waveform and numeric parameters. Write a pre-shift monitoring checklist to /home/ga/Desktop/monitoring_checklist.txt listing each of the three device types you configured, the physiological parameters each device monitors, and a confirmation statement that all devices showed active data flow. Consider clinically appropriate parameters for a post-cardiac surgery patient in your documentation. OpenICE Supervisor is already running on the desktop.
